text:
Alex P.: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to track remediation for the KV-cache memory/fragmentation OOM. I sketched action items below, please claim owners and ETA.

Maria K.: I can own detailed profiling (heap + KV usage across tenants). Plan: reproduce with perftest, capture heapdumps at 5s intervals, run jemalloc stats. Target: initial findings by Thu EOD. :calendar:

Samir: I'll take allocator/GC tuning and fragmentation investigation. Look into switching to jemalloc background defrag and adjust arena settings. Also want to check large-allocation patterns in bulk load paths. ETA: next Tue. :mag:

Jenna: I'll handle immediate mitigation: implement soft memory limits per shard + auto-throttle to prevent cascading restarts. Also prepare a rolling restart playbook. Can have a canary policy ready by Mon. :gear:

Alex P.: Good — add one item for long-term: KV eviction heuristics and TTL tuning to prevent slow growth patterns (owner: ?). Also log-level additions for allocation hot paths.

Maria K.: I'll add the eviction heuristics to the profiling ticket if no one else picks it up.

InfraBot: Incident report: <https://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-0421> — alert history and deploys attached.

Samir: For reproducibility, here's the quick snippet I used to exercise the cache:
```bash
# simple loader that creates ~1M large keys
for i in $(seq 1 1000000); do curl -s -X POST http://kv.local/load -d \"key=k_$i&value=$(head -c 1024 /dev/urandom | base64)\"; done
```

Jenna: For immediate ops, add this to the oncall playbook (under Memory > KV cache):
- Increase soft limit on the canary pool to 12GB
- Enable throttling at 70% of soft limit
- Add alert if fragmentation ratio > 1.4 for 3m

Alex P.: I'm going to create a tracking board and PR the postmortem updates. Please post your ticket IDs here once created. Also flag any blockers (access, infra windows).

Maria K.: Ticket: RT-4123 (profiling + heapdumps). I've scheduled a run on staging tonight 02:00 UTC.

Samir: Ticket: RT-4131 (allocator tuning + fragmentation analysis). Need permission to restart two canary nodes in staging between 03:00-04:00 UTC — @Alex P. can you approve?

Alex P.: Approved for the staging window. :white_check_mark:

Jenna: Ticket: RT-4134 (soft-limits + throttling + restart playbook). I linked the canary policy and rollback steps.

Maria K.: Early note from today's run: vrt histograms show steady KV-value size spike on tenant-42, likely retention bug. Dumping stack traces now.

Samir: If it's tenant-specific we should add tenant quota enforcement ASAP. That could be a fast mitigation while we fix retention.

Alex P.: Agreed — add tenant quotas as a policy item. Owner? Jenna or Infra?

Jenna: I can add quota enforcement as an ops config (low-risk), but will need infra to support per-tenant enforcement hooks. Added to RT-4134.

InfraBot: Reminder: weekly oncall sync scheduled Fri 09:00 UTC to review remediation progress.

Alex P.: Summary: Owners/plans so far -> Maria (profiling, RT-4123, Thu EOD), Samir (allocator/fragments, RT-4131, Tue), Jenna (mitigations + quotas + playbook, RT-4134, Mon). Next check-in: Fri oncall sync. Please paste short updates in this thread before Friday. :eyes:
